releaseBoundary.note: Freeze an intentional public release; do not archive operational/private material merely because it exists in the repository.

steps: Choose and record a dataset release version.
Freeze the reviewed public release files and compute SHA-256 checksums.
Publish the frozen release through Zenodo or another appropriate persistent archive.
Verify the archive record and issued DOI.
Update this file, data/dataset.jsonld and CITATION.cff with the issued DOI without rewriting historical release identity.

guardrails: No DOI is claimed before an external archive issues one.
Dataset publication is a citation and reproducibility mechanism, not a Search ranking guarantee.
Medical or clinical authority is not implied by dataset publication.
